description: This file defines the AWS\IotDataPlane\IotDataPlaneClient class, which is a client used to interact with the AWS IoT Data Plane service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as getting and updating thing shadows and managing retained messages.

classes.name: IotDataPlaneClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS IoT Data Plane service, providing methods for managing shadows and retained messages.

methods.name: deleteThingShadow
methods.description: Deletes the shadow document for a thing.

methods.name: deleteThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the shadow document for a thing.

methods.name: getThingShadow
methods.description: Retrieves the shadow document for a thing.

methods.name: getThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the shadow document for a thing.

methods.name: listNamedShadowsForThing
methods.description: Lists the names of all shadows for a thing.

methods.name: listNamedShadowsForThingAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists the names of all shadows for a thing.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic.

methods.name: publishAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously publishes a message to a topic.

methods.name: updateThingShadow
methods.description: Updates the shadow document for a thing.

methods.name: updateThingShadowAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the shadow document for a thing.
